integrity: Finite checks supplement, rather than certify, the universally quantified mathematical proof. The motivating preconditioned update and classical one-factor projector geometry are credited to prior literature.
scientific_limitations: Exact-arithmetic, arbitrary admissible diagonal switching with unit keys and at least two key coordinates. The exhibited blow-up uses zero targets; no instability of any particular learned optimizer trajectory or trained sequence model is claimed.
title: Sharp finite-horizon amplification of diagonally preconditioned delta-rule erasures
